carrier: Frozen architecture,8^3,128 candidates,centered bounds and original RGB/metriccamera/raydistance semantics
old_data: All3 scenes retained, no ai003 exclusion even if officially bad

unseen_plan.selection: deterministic scene-name order, distinct source asset/volume from train and each other, existing protocol_partition=train only, never protected/test
unseen_plan.identity: must verify authoritative source-asset mapping; different IDs alone insufficient
unseen_plan.frame_quality_rule: require official included image and valid camera-trajectory classification; finite RGB/depth; reject frame if all RGB pixels exactly zero or >99.9% pixels have all channels<=2/255, or GT valid fraction<0.95
unseen_plan.frame_pool: first16 valid jointly present frames of cam00, bounded ranges only; no score search
unseen_plan.roles: select matching-support A/B of3 sharing anchor using camera/GT-only rule fixed before images/model; exact IDs locked only after quality/support audit
unseen_plan.fallback: if insufficient data/identity, UNSEEN_DEV_STATUS=BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_DATA; no training-scene substitute

residual.class: Existing ResidualReadoutControl; frozen carrier state, head only
residual.selection: lowest scene-equal internal validation RGB MSE+depth AbsRel, tie earliest; no unseen data
residual.training_sufficiency: report objective/validation curves and limitations, never assert convergence just from step count

statistic.primary: anchor depthAbsRel minus average(full context A,B) depthAbsRel; also both contexts separate
statistic.wrong_scene: cyclic donor A state in scene-name order at unchanged target query camera

diagnostics_only: state masking all typedfields with deterministic zero-density/zero-color/features
residual wrong-scene and zero-state at unchangedquerycamera
